name: Tinyusb Keyboard → Press
description: Presses one key, releasing any key pressed before. The key stays pressed until [`tinyusb_keyboard.release`](https://esphome.io/components/tinyusb_keyboard/#tinyusb_keyboard-release-action) is called. Only the latest state is kept, so put a short [`delay`](https://esphome.io/automations/actions/#delay-action) of at least `20ms` between consecutive key actions in one automation, otherwise a press can replace a release that the host has not received yet.

config_entries.label: Key
config_entries.description: The key to press, as a single lowercase letter or digit, or as a HID keyboard usage id (for example `0x28` for Enter). Quote digits, since an unquoted number is taken as a usage id.

config_entries.label: Modifiers
config_entries.description: Bitmask of modifier keys held with the key: `0x01` Left Ctrl, `0x02` Left Shift, `0x04` Left Alt, `0x08` Left GUI, and the same four bits shifted left by four for the right-hand keys. Defaults to `0`.
